dict.string: Provenance uses Bluetooth to support game controllers.
Provenance uses file provider for loading ROMs.
Provenance uses the local network to find and communicate with AltServer and to discover netplay rooms for multiplayer gaming.
Provenance uses the microphone for systems that support audio input (eg. Famicom).
Provenance uses your device's accelerometer and gyroscope to emulate the portable consoles' built-in accelerometer and gyroscope.
Provenance can set custom artworks from your photos or save screenshots to the Photo Library.
